content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Design assets

The core issue at hand is the lack of accessible payment infrastructure for digital creators in many regions. Conventional platforms like Gumroad impose significant fees—up to 10%—on sales, which can erode profits quickly. In contrast, using a sovereign stack enables creators to retain more of their earnings, allowing them to price competitively and reach a broader audience. With the rise of cryptocurrencies, creators can leverage these for transactions, making it possible to sell design assets directly to consumers without the burden of platform fees.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, a sovereign digital commerce stack comprises several key components working in harmony. First, the hosting environment is built on platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, enabling creators to showcase their products for free. Next, backend logic is managed through Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which automates order processing. With NOWPayments, creators can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, ensuring low transaction fees and immediate payment confirmation. This architecture not only streamlines the selling process but also allows for complete ownership and control over your digital assets.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is specifically designed for digital creators—graphic designers, writers, educators, and developers—who need a reliable way to monetize their work without the constraints of traditional payment platforms. If you are selling ebooks, courses, or design templates, this infrastructure gives you the tools to operate independently. It’s built for those who understand the value of owning their commerce systems and are ready to take control of their financial future by leveraging cryptocurrencies for payments.
Retain more of your earnings with crypto payments—NOWPayments charges just 0.5%.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The effectiveness of this infrastructure lies in its seamless integration of various components. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages host your online store, while backend solutions like Google Sheets or Supabase manage your product orders. NOWPayments allows for real-time cryptocurrency payment processing, ensuring you receive funds almost instantly. Each element is designed to be user-friendly and cost-effective, providing a comprehensive solution that eliminates reliance on traditional payment processing platforms.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To start selling your design assets with crypto payments, first, choose your preferred hosting service—GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up backend logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Afterward, integrate NOWPayments to facilitate cryptocurrency transactions. Finally, upload your digital products and configure delivery through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. For a complete solution, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all the necessary blueprints and templates to get your sovereign commerce stack up and running.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
Own your entire sales process with no platform dependencies.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're interested in scaling your digital product sales, explore the Complete Builder Kit ($197) available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. This kit provides comprehensive blueprints and templates to help you set up a fully functional online store without relying on conventional payment processors.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
